name: Salmon hotpot
summary: Lẩu cá hồi is salmon hotpot, the centerpiece of the salmon meal at the Silver Waterfall restaurant and on several town menus.
origin: Sa Pa salmon kitchens, led by the restaurant at Silver Waterfall.
howToEat: Order one pot to share at the table, with the salad or the grilled salmon beside it.
where: Nhà hàng thác Bạc near the Silver Waterfall gate, Cá Hồi Vua on Lê Văn Tám, and Gia Bảo on Võ Thị Sáu.
seoTitle: Salmon hotpot in Sapa — the falls and the town
seoDescription: Lẩu cá hồi at the Silver Waterfall restaurant, Cá Hồi Vua, and Gia Bảo in Sa Pa.
